subject: Peninsula of Power
text: Northeast of Pravoka, the very tip of a two-space wide peninsula allows fighting strong northern continent enemies due to a bug, which can be beaten at level 9 or 10 with FIR2 and HRM2.

evidence.quote:
Northeast of Pravoka there is a thin penninsula that, due to a bug in the
game, allows you to fight enemies from the northern continent. it only works
on the very tip of the two space wide penninsula and the enemies are rather
strong, but if you are on at least lv 9 or 10 and you have the spells FIR2 and
HRM2 you can beat them.

subject: Elfland
text: Elfland sells Level 3 magic including Cur2, Afir, and Fir2 for Red Mages, Cur2 and Afir for White Mages, and Fir2 and Lit2 for Black Mages.

evidence.quote:
The Level 3 magic you should get is Cur2, Afir, and Fir2 for Red Mages, Cur2 and 
Afir for White Mages, and Fir2 and Lit2 for Black Mages.

subject: Elfland
text: Elfland sells Level 4 magic including Aice, Fast, and Ice2 for Red Mages, Pure and Aice for White Mages, and Fast and Ice2 for Black Mages.

evidence.quote:
The Level 4 magic you 
should get is Aice, Fast, and Ice2 for Red Mages, Pure and Aice for White Mages, 
and Fast and Ice2 for Black Mages.

subject: Elfland
text: Heal Potions and Pure Potions can be purchased in Elfland to prepare for dungeons and poisonous creatures.

evidence.quote:
You'll need Heal Potions for the 
dungeons, and Pure Potions for the poisonous creatures running around.

subject: Northwest Castle
text: To reach Northwest Castle from Elfland, go west between two mountain ranges, northwest through the forest to a river and lake, then north.

evidence.quote:
Go west until you see a 
space between two mountain ranges.  Travel northwest through the forest until 
you see a small river and lake.  At that point, go north and you'll find the 
castle.

subject: King of Northwest Castle
text: The lone king in Northwest Castle asks the party to retrieve his Crown from the Cave of Marsh after being double-crossed by Astos.

evidence.quote:
He informs you that Astos double-crossed 
him, stealing his Crown and taking it to the Cave of Marsh.  The king wants you 
to retrieve it for him.

subject: Cave of Marsh
text: To reach the Cave of Marsh from Elfland, travel to the river and lake, go west between mountain ranges, and head south through swampland.

evidence.quote:
To reach the Cave of Marsh from Elfland, go back to 
where the river and lake was.  Instead of going north, go west through a space 
between mountain ranges, and then turn and go south through some swampland.  
You'll spot a hole in the ground.  This is the Cave of Marsh.

subject: Cave of Marsh
text: Before entering the Cave of Marsh, players should carry at least 50 Heal Potions and 15 Pure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Before you enter it, make sure you've got at 
least 50 Heal Potions and 15 Pure Potions.

subject: Cave of Marsh 1st floor
text: From the center of the first floor of the Cave of Marsh, the north and south paths lead to stairs while east is a dead end.

evidence.quote:
1st floor - You start in the center of this floor.  You can go either north, 
south, or east.  North and south leads to stairs, east a dead end.

subject: Cave of Marsh 2nd floor
text: The northwest room of the second floor via the north stairs contains 680 gold.

evidence.quote:
2nd floor (north stairs) -  

Northwest room:  680 gold

subject: Cave of Marsh 2nd floor
text: The northeast room of the second floor via the north stairs contains a Large Dagger.

evidence.quote: Northeast room:  Large Dagger

subject: Cave of Marsh 2nd floor
text: The southwest room of the second floor via the north stairs contains 620 gold and a Short Sword.

evidence.quote: Southwest room:  620 gold, Short Sword

subject: Cave of Marsh 3rd floor
text: On the third floor of the Cave of Marsh, the first room in the first row contains Iron Armor.

evidence.quote:
3rd floor - This floor has 16 rooms in a 4 x 4 layout.

1st row, 1st room - Iron Armor

subject: Cave of Marsh 3rd floor
text: On the third floor of the Cave of Marsh, the fourth room in the first row contains 295 gold.

evidence.quote: 1st row, 4th room - 295 gold

subject: Cave of Marsh 3rd floor
text: On the third floor of the Cave of Marsh, the first room in the second row contains a Copper Bracelet.

evidence.quote: 2nd row, 1st room - Copper Bracelet

subject: Cave of Marsh 3rd floor
text: On the third floor of the Cave of Marsh, the second room in the second row contains a House.

evidence.quote: 2nd row, 2nd room - House

subject: Cave of Marsh 3rd floor
text: On the third floor of the Cave of Marsh, the second room in the third row contains the Crown guarded by a battle with Wizards.

evidence.quote: 3rd row, 2nd room - Crown (battle with Wizards)

subject: Cave of Marsh 3rd floor
text: On the third floor of the Cave of Marsh, the third room in the third row contains 385 gold.

evidence.quote: 3rd row, 3rd room - 385 gold

subject: Astos
text: Astos has 168 HP and can cast Rub, Slo2, Fast, Fir2, Lit2, Slow, Dark, and Slep.

evidence.quote:
BOSS:  ASTOS
HP: 168
Magic:  Rub, Slo2, Fast, Fir2, Lit2, Slow, Dark, Slep

subject: Astos
text: Astos should be silenced with Mute before he casts instant-kill Rub, and damaged using Black Mage attack spells due to his low magic resistance.

evidence.quote:
Whoever you designate as the 
healer (either Red or White Mage) should cast Mute on Astos as soon as possible, 
hopefully before he can get that killer Rub spell off...The Black Mage is important because Astos doesn't have much resistance 
to magic so whip out your best attacking spells.

subject: Astos
text: Defeating Astos in Northwest Castle rewards Matoya's Crystal.

evidence.quote: When you win, you'll get back Matoya's Crystal.

subject: Matoya
text: Returning the Crystal to Matoya in Matoya's Cave earns an Herb that wakes the Prince of Elfland.

evidence.quote:
In return for giving her the Crystal back, she'll give you a Herb which can wake 
the Prince of Elfland.

subject: Prince of Elfland
text: Giving the Herb to the Prince's assistant in Elfland Castle awakens the Prince, who gives the party the Mystic Key.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the assistant guarding the Prince, and he will give him the Herb.  The 
Prince, awakened, will now give you the Mystic Key, like the legend said.

subject: Elfland Castle Treasury
text: The locked Elfland Castle Treasury contains a Silver Hammer, Copper Gauntlet, and 730 gold.

evidence.quote: Elfland Castle Treasury:  Silver Hammer, Copper Gauntlet, 730 gold

subject: Coneria Castle Treasury
text: The locked Coneria Castle Treasury contains Iron Armor, Iron Shield, TNT, Iron Staff, Sabre, and Silver Dagger.

evidence.quote:
Coneria Castle Treasury:  Iron Armor, Iron Shield, TNT, Iron Staff, Sabre,
 Silver Dagger

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: The locked rooms in the Temple of Fiends contain the Rune Sword, Were Sword, and a Soft Potion.

evidence.quote: Temple of Fiends:  Rune Sword, Were Sword, Soft Potion

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: The locked treasury in the Dwarf Cave contains a Cabin, Iron Helmet, Dragon Sword, Silver Knife, Wooden Helmet, Silver Armor, House, and 575 gold.

evidence.quote:
Dwarf Cave:  Cabin, Iron Helmet, Dragon Sword, Silver Knife, Wooden Helmet,
 Silver Armor, House, 575 gold

subject: Northwest Castle Treasury
text: The locked Northwest Castle Treasury contains a Power Staff, Falchion, and Iron Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Northwest Castle Treasury:  Power Staff, Falchion, Iron Gauntlet

subject: Cave of Marsh
text: The locked rooms in the Marsh Cave contain a Silver Bracelet, Silver Knife, and 1020 gold.

evidence.quote: Marsh Cave:  Silver Bracelet, Silver Knife, 1020 gold

subject: Nerrick
text: Giving the TNT found in Coneria to the Dwarf Nerrick allows him to finish his canal and open passage out of the Aldi Sea.

evidence.quote:
The TNT you found in Coneria is to be 
given to the Dwarf Nerrick, so he can finish his canal.  Remember the little 
strip of land blocking passage to the west?  That will be gone now and you can 
exit the Aldi Sea.

subject: Melmond
text: Melmond sells Cur3 and Fir3 for Red Mages, Cur3 and Life for White Mages, and Fir3 for Black Mages.

evidence.quote:
The magic to 
buy is Cur3 and Fir3 for Red Mages, Cur3 and Life for White Mages, and Fir3 for 
Black Mages.

subject: Melmond
text: Melmond has no Item Shop, requiring trips back to Elfland or Coneria to buy Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Note that there is no Item Shop in Melmond, so you will have to 
return to either Elfland or Coneria to buy Heal Potions.

subject: Earth Cave
text: To reach the Earth Cave, head west from Melmond until grassland leads south, then continue to a mountain cave with a small swamp in front.

evidence.quote:
To get there, head west 
from Melmond until you see grassland that leads south.  Travel that way and 
you'll find a mountain cave with a small swamp in front of it.  This is the 
Earth Cave.

subject: Earth Cave 1st Floor
text: The north path on the 1st floor of the Earth Cave leads to a treasure room with 1975 gold.

evidence.quote: North path:  Treasure room with 1975 gold

subject: Earth Cave 1st Floor
text: Following the southeast path and turning left on the 1st floor of the Earth Cave leads to a treasure room with 880 gold and a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote: Southeast path, then left:  Treasure room with 880 gold and a Heal Potion

subject: Earth Cave 1st Floor
text: Following the southeast path and turning right on the 1st floor of the Earth Cave leads to a treasure room with 795 gold and a Pure Potion.

evidence.quote: Southeast path, then right:  Treasure room with 795 gold and a Pure Potion

subject: Earth Cave 2nd Floor
text: The northeastern room on the 2nd floor of the Earth Cave contains a Coral Sword, Cabin, and 330 gold.

evidence.quote: Northeastern room:  Coral Sword, Cabin, 330 gold

subject: Earth Cave 2nd Floor
text: The south room on the 2nd floor of the Earth Cave contains a Wooden Shield and 5575 gold.

evidence.quote: South room:  Wooden Shield, 5575 gold

subject: Earth Cave 3rd Floor
text: The southeastern room on the 3rd floor of the Earth Cave contains a Tent.

evidence.quote: Southeastern room:  Tent

subject: Earth Cave 3rd Floor
text: The eastern room on the 3rd floor of the Earth Cave contains a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote: Eastern room:  Heal Potion

subject: Earth Cave 3rd Floor
text: The northern room on the 3rd floor of the Earth Cave contains 3400 gold.

evidence.quote: Northern room:  3400 gold

subject: Earth Cave 3rd Floor
text: The western room on the 3rd floor of the Earth Cave contains 1020 gold.

evidence.quote: Western room:  1020 gold

subject: Vampire
text: Vampire has 156 HP, uses the special attack Dazzle (Stun), and is weak to Fire spells and Harm because he is undead.

evidence.quote:
BOSS:  VAMPIRE
HP: 156
Special Attacks:  Dazzle(Stun)...your Mages should use Fire spells on him, 
since he is a member of the undead, which also means Harm works, too.

subject: Vampire
text: The treasure chest behind Vampire contains the Ruby.

evidence.quote: The treasure chest behind him contains the Ruby.

subject: Titan
text: Giving the Ruby to the Titan in Titan's Tunnel allows free passage through the tunnel.

evidence.quote:
When you talk to the Titan with the Ruby in your possession, he'll take it from 
you, eat it (!), and then allow you free passage from now on.

subject: Titan's Treasury
text: Titan's Treasury contains a Silver Helmet, Great Axe, and 1070 gold.

evidence.quote: Titan's Treasury:  Silver Helmet, Great Axe, 1070 gold

subject: Sarda
text: Talking to the sage Sarda in his cave rewards the Rod to use on the Stone Plate.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the old sage and he will give you the Rod.  This is what to use on that 
Stone Plate.

subject: Stone Plate
text: Using the Rod from the Item screen shatters the Stone Plate in Earth Cave, revealing a stairway down.

evidence.quote:
Use the Rod (by going to the Item 
screen) and the plate will shatter, revealing a stairway.

subject: Earth Cave 4th Floor
text: The northern room on the 4th floor of the Earth Cave contains a Wooden Staff and 11825 gold.

evidence.quote: Northern room:  Wooden Staff, 11825 gold

subject: Earth Cave 4th Floor
text: The southwestern room on the 4th floor of the Earth Cave contains a Silver Shield, Cabin, and 1250 gold.

evidence.quote: Southwestern room:  Silver Shield, Cabin, 1250 gold

subject: Lich
text: Lich has 400 HP and casts Ice2, Slp2, Fast, Lit2, Hold, Fir2, Slow, and Slep.

evidence.quote:
BOSS:  LICH  
HP: 400
Magic:  Ice2, Slp2, Fast, Lit2, Hold, Fir2, Slow, Slep

subject: Lich
text: Lich is immune to Mute; defend against his spells using Aice, Alit, and Afir, and cast Fast on fighters while keeping Mages from physically attacking.

evidence.quote:
Mute does not work on him; he's too powerful.  So, 
instead, cast your anti-elemental spells (Aice, Alit, Afir) to significantly 
decrease the damage done by his attack spells.  You should also use Fast on your 
fighters so they can inflict more damage on Lich.  Your Mages should never 
attack because they will only do 1 damage.

subject: Earth Orb
text: Stepping on the altar in front of the teleporter after defeating Lich restores power to the Earth Orb and activates a teleporter to the cave entrance.

evidence.quote:
When you step on the altar in front of the teleporter, a gray light will rise 
from the ground.  This indicates that an Orb has regained its power.  If you 
check the menu screen, you'll see that your bottom-right Orb shines once again.  
Three more to go!  Touch the teleporter and you will be transported to the cave 
entrance.

subject: Crescent Lake
text: To reach Crescent Lake, sail west of Melmond around the Earth Cave peninsula to a port, then travel southwest through grassland and forest.

evidence.quote:
Go around the Earth 
Cave peninsula and sail west until you run into land.  You should see a port.  
Dock here and head southwest through grassland and forest and you should spot 
the town of Crescent Lake.
